clue.text: British managed to travel back in pristine condition

parts.note: to manage a business is to run it, past tense ran

indicators.note: back tells us the word for travelling is read from right to left

parts.note: to wend is to travel or make one's way

explanation.surface: Something British was run back to look as good as the day it was made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' sends the word for travelling in reverse after the British and managed pieces; 'in pristine condition' is the whole definition, not just 'pristine'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fresh from the shop, never used, is in perfect, untouched condition.

clue.text: Lie suggesting Marie Antoinette's extremely cruel at heart?

indicators.note: at heart places the letters from cruel into the middle of the French queen's title

parts.note: Marie Antoinette was the queen of France, and the French for queen is reine

indicators.note: extremely asks for the extreme letters of cruel, its first and last

explanation.surface: A query whether a story about the French queen hints that she was cruel deep down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' takes the first and last letters of 'cruel'; 'at heart' sets them inside the French queen's title, since Marie Antoinette was queen of France.
explanation.definitionFit: To lie back on a sofa or bed is to rest in a leaning or horizontal position.

clue.text: Pigment carried by nobody but yourself

indicators.note: carried by says the pigment sits inside the word for nobody, held within it

parts.note: nobody means none, not one person
umber is a brown earth pigment used in paints

explanation.surface: A tin of paint that nobody but you will carry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carried by' sets the brown pigment inside the word for nobody; 'yourself' is defined via the idiom of looking after number one.
explanation.definitionFit: Looking after number one is an idiom for looking after your own interests, so the phrase stands for the self.

clue.text: Wealthy individual in Scottish port subverted bishop

indicators.note: subverted, literally turned from below, says the port's name is turned around (in a down clue, upside down)

parts.note: Oban is a ferry port on the west coast of Scotland
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A rich man in a Scottish harbour town undermines the local bishop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'subverted' turns the port's name upside down in this down clue; OBAN is a ferry town on Scotland's west coast.
explanation.definitionFit: A nabob was originally a European who came home rich from India, so the word names a very wealthy person.

clue.text: Where Third World water-carrier is treated?

definitions.text: Where Third World water-carrier is treated?

parts.words: Where Third World water-carrier is treated?
parts.note: a woman who carries water from a well in a developing country could jokingly be called a woman of the well, and the clue imagines a medical centre for her

explanation.surface: A question about where a woman fetching water in a poor country gets medical care.
explanation.walkthrough: The surgery name really means a clinic for women's routine health checks; the clue reads 'well' as a water source instead of good health.
explanation.definitionFit: A clinic offering health screening for women is named for keeping them in good health, while the clue pictures a woman at a water source.

clue.text: Use Palestinians found for instrument in foreign legation

indicators.note: found for says the Palestinians are put in place of, substituted for, the instrument
in says the instrument being swapped out sits inside the word for the foreign legation

parts.note: an embassy is the mission of a foreign government
a bass is a musical instrument, such as a double bass or bass guitar
PLO stands for the Palestine Liberation Organization

explanation.surface: A plan to use some Palestinians who were found an instrument at a foreign embassy.
explanation.walkthrough: In EMBASSY, BASS is replaced by PLO, leaving EM + PLO + Y.
explanation.definitionFit: To employ a tool or method is to make use of it.

clue.text: Level of responsibility given city man — 50% of capital

parts.note: EC is the postcode for the City of London, the financial district
he is the pronoun for a man

indicators.note: 50% of asks for half of the capital's name, its first three letters

parts.note: London is the capital of the UK

explanation.surface: A city businessman is given responsibility for half of the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: '50% of' takes LON from LONDON.
explanation.definitionFit: An echelon is a rank or tier within an organisation, a grade of authority.

clue.text: Braid made in Poland, on small island

parts.note: PL is the international vehicle code for Poland
an ait or eyot is a small island in a river, especially the Thames

explanation.surface: A braid made in Poland while on a tiny island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' in a down clue means the island sits below Poland's code; an ait is a small island in a river, especially the Thames.
explanation.definitionFit: A plait is hair or strands woven together, the same as a braid.

clue.text: Vatican bishop based in European Union involved in cricket side's defeat

indicators.note: involved in puts the whole Vatican group inside the letters for the cricket side

parts.note: the on side, also called the leg side, is one half of a cricket field
V is the international vehicle code for Vatican City

indicators.note: based in says the bishop's letters are set inside the European Union's letters

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop

explanation.surface: Papal and EU officials are mixed up in the downfall of a cricket team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'based in' sets the bishop inside the EU letters, after the Vatican code; 'involved in' then puts the lot inside the cricket side. In cricket, the on side is the half of the field behind the batsman's legs.
explanation.definitionFit: An army that overruns its enemy defeats it and sweeps through its positions.

clue.text: Carbon in addition produces layer of impurity

indicators.note: in places the symbol for carbon within the word for addition

parts.note: a sum is an addition of figures
C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: A chemistry note that adding carbon creates a dirty layer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts C inside SUM.
explanation.definitionFit: Scum is the film of dirt or froth that floats on top of a liquid.

clue.text: of Theseus?

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'of Theseus? (4-6)' is cut short: the opening words, which hold the definition, are missing and no source found gives them.

clue.text: Draw Swede limbo dancing

indicators.note: dancing has the letters of the two words jigging about into a new order

explanation.surface: A sketch of a Swedish man doing the limbo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draw' looks like sketching, but it is the old word for gutting, as in 'hanged, drawn and quartered'; 'dancing' rearranges SWEDELIMBO.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw a bird or a criminal was to remove the entrails, which is to gut them.

clue.text: "Mountain Lake" Services

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, one of the armed services
RN is the Royal Navy, another of the armed services

explanation.surface: A sign for the motorway services at a beauty spot called Mountain Lake.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface looks like a café sign; 'Services' gives two British armed forces, the Territorial Army (volunteer reserve) and the Royal Navy.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarn is a small lake in a hollow high in the hills, a word used in the English Lake District.

clue.text: Headless garden ornament left lying around, useless thing

indicators.note: lying around says the pieces are turned to face the other way
Headless says the ornament's word loses its first letter

parts.note: a gnome is a little statue placed in gardens

explanation.surface: A garden gnome with its head knocked off lies abandoned, no use to anyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Headless' takes G off GNOME to leave NOME; L follows, and 'lying around' turns NOMEL into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A car or product that fails to work is called a dud in slang, in British and American usage alike.

clue.text: Last word by doctor attached to hospital department for a change

parts.note: amen is the word said at the end of a prayer
DM is Doctor of Medicine, a medical degree
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department of a hospital

explanation.surface: A doctor in a hospital department has the final say on a change of plan.
explanation.walkthrough: DM, Doctor of Medicine, is the less familiar order of MD.
explanation.definitionFit: An amendment is an alteration made to a text, law or plan.

clue.text: Lots of potential, see, in hopelessly lost game?

indicators.note: in puts the letter for see inside the jumbled words
hopelessly says the letters of the two words are in a hopeless muddle

parts.note: V stands for vide, Latin for see, used in references

explanation.surface: A reflection on how much promise was wasted in a game lost without hope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hopelessly' rearranges LOSTGAME into MEGAOLTS, and 'in' puts V inside it. 'Potential' means talent in the surface but electrical voltage in the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrical potential is measured in volts, and a megavolt is a million of them.

clue.text: Abandon turbulent scene

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Abandon turbulent scene (9)' gives QUIT around an anagram of SCENE but has no definition and no container indicator: words appear to be missing and no source found gives them.

clue.text: Mysterious nun about to care for knight without delay

indicators.note: to care for pictures the nun's letters holding and looking after the knight and the word for at once
about signals that the letters of nun are moved around

parts.note: K is the chess notation for a knight
now means at once, without delay

explanation.surface: A strange nun is about to look after a knight straight away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges the nun's letters to UNN; 'to care for' wraps them round the knight and the word for without delay.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is not known or understood is mysterious, beyond our knowledge.

clue.text: Bag provided by airline

definitions.meaning: a ..., short for ... bag, is a plastic or paper shopping bag
an airline company is called a ..., as it carries passengers

explanation.definitionFit: One word names both a shopping bag with handles and a company that transports passengers by air.

clue.text: Stove lit once more

parts.note: an Aga is a heavy cast-iron range cooker, a British brand
a fire that is lit is said to be in

explanation.surface: A stove has been lit for a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: An AGA is a big cast-iron kitchen range popular in British country houses; a fire that is burning is 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: To do something again is to do it a further time, once more.

clue.text: On behalf of someone else, it turns out

indicators.note: out is the anagram signal: the letters of the two words are put out of their order

explanation.surface: Someone discovers that what they did was in fact for another person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges ITTURNS; 'it turns out' reads as a stock phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Money held in trust is held by a trustee for the benefit of another person.

clue.text: Cook raw chopped vegetable

indicators.note: chopped says the two words are cut short at each end, leaving the letters inside

explanation.surface: A recipe instruction: cook the raw chopped vegetable.
explanation.walkthrough: Cut the ends off COOKRAW to leave the answer, after a stray O.
explanation.definitionFit: Okra, also called ladies' fingers, is a green pod vegetable.

clue.text: Bank opening at four it appears in theory

indicators.note: opening says the word for bank is opened up so the other pieces can go inside

parts.note: to bank on something is to rely on it
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A bank opening at four o'clock appears in some theory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opening' sets the at, four and it pieces inside the word for bank. 'Bank' looks like a building with opening hours, but it is a verb, to bank on.
explanation.definitionFit: Relativity is Einstein's theory of space, time and gravity.

clue.text: Material traditionally used like lace, evidently small amounts only

indicators.note: small amounts only says we take just a little from each word, the first letter

explanation.surface: A note on a fabric that has always been used like lace.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening letters of 'traditionally used like lace, evidently' spell the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Tulle is a fine silk or nylon netting, a fabric used for veils and ballet dresses.

clue.text: Slap on vital oil with deliberate intention

indicators.note: Slap, as in slapdash, says the letters are thrown together carelessly into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone deliberately slaps essential oil on their skin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Slap' rearranges ONVITALOIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A volitional act comes from free will, done on purpose by choice.

clue.text: Praise for boy entering university?

indicators.note: entering says the university letter goes into the word for boy

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: Praise is due for a boy who has got into university.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' puts U inside LAD.
explanation.definitionFit: To laud someone is to extol or speak highly of them.

clue.text: Charm, object attracting attention

parts.note: an end is an object or aim, as in 'to that end'
to have someone's ear is to have their attention

explanation.surface: A charming item that catches people's eye.
explanation.walkthrough: 'attracting' is a link word: END comes first, then EAR.
explanation.definitionFit: To endear yourself is to make others fond of you, to win them over.

clue.text: Application for fencing course?

parts.note: fencing suggests a sword-fighting class, but here it means garden fences, and the application is a coat of wood preservative brushed on

explanation.surface: A form someone fills in to join a fencing class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Application' looks like a form and 'fencing course' like a class, but the clue means a protective coat brushed on to wooden fences.
explanation.definitionFit: Creosote is a tarry oil painted on to timber fences and sheds to preserve them.
